senses.sense_definition: To infer or predict something unknown by extending or applying known information or trends.

examples.text: Scientists <w>extrapolate</w> future climate patterns based on historical data collected over the last century.
It is difficult to <w>extrapolate</w> the success of this small pilot program to the entire national population.

senses.sense_definition: To estimate a value outside a known range by assuming the trend continues logically from the known data.

examples.text: The analyst used the growth figures from the first quarter to <w>extrapolate</w> the total annual revenue.
We can <w>extrapolate</w> the curve on the graph to see where the price might be next year.
